answer_1.quote: We propose the novel tasks of (a) aligning high-level draft feedback to specific edits and (b) generating revisions for scientific papers given reviewer feedback.
answer_1.outputs: Edits to scientific papers (paragraphs of text)

answer_4.quote: We explore the differences between GPT-written and author-written edits more deeply with an analysis by two expert judges (authors of this paper, with multiple CS/ML publications) on 85 comments.
answer_4.guideline: The judges scored edits using several specific factors described in the following rubric: Compliance (1-3), Promises (true/false), Paraphrases (true/false), Technical details (true/false).
